session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Spike and Channel to Midday Reversal then Trading Range'. After a gap down a climactic bear spike reaches the 2R measured move; triple top failure and a 42-bar EMA gap bear channel grind the market to 7555 where an overshoot exhaustion final leg forms the low. Midday bull wedge and multiple double bottoms reverse the market up to 7588, but the trending range rolls over and the close sells back to 7562.

events.label: climax
events.raw_label: Gap down - pause - Climactic Bear spike down to 2R
events.outcome_reason: climactic bear spike after the gap down reached the 2R measured move of yesterday bear wedge
events.evidence: red arrow sell bars 09:45-10:05 with 'Climactic Bear spike' red text and brown 2R lines

events.label: wedge
events.outcome_reason: wedge bear flag to the EMA led to continued bear selling
events.evidence: magenta arrow into the 10:15 bear flag under 7600

events.label: double_top
events.raw_label: Triple Top fails to Breakout and bears sell for MM of breakout bear spike
events.outcome_reason: triple top failed to breakout to the upside and the bears sold for the measured move below
events.evidence: magenta Triple Top dotted lines at 7600 with sell bars below

events.label: channel
events.raw_label: Bears sustain EMA gap x 42 bars; bear channel down
events.outcome_reason: black dotted bear channel ground the market from 7600 down to 7555
events.evidence: black dotted parallel channel lines from 10:45 to the 12:55 low

events.label: wedge
events.raw_label: Final Leg overshoots channel trendline - exhaustion signal
events.outcome_reason: final leg beyond the channel trendline marked exhaustion and the day low at 7555 held
events.evidence: red arrow at the 12:55 low below the channel line with oversized red bar

events.label: double_bottom
events.raw_label: Higher Low with Multiple Double Bottoms
events.outcome_reason: higher low double bottoms lifted the market off the low into the midday rally
events.evidence: green horizontal dotted lines at 7557-7560 with green boxed bull bars

events.label: wedge
events.outcome_reason: midday wedge of higher lows reversed the market up to 7588 into the EMA
events.evidence: magenta dotted wedged uptrend lines from the 12:55 low to the 14:45 high

events.label: trading_range
events.raw_label: After opening climactic sell, trending trading range; limit bulls buy low, limit bears sell high
events.outcome_reason: afternoon became a trading range near the EMA that broke down into the close at 7562
events.evidence: blue boxed ranges 15:00-15:40 with close sell bars to 7562
